summary: CorrespondenceCohortSchedule is a data-layer entity and set of system workflows used to manage correspondence schedules for educational cohorts within a timetable structure. It supports CRUD operations, schedule inheritance, due date calculations, and localized field descriptions.
purpose: To track, manage, generate, update, and schedule correspondence deliverables at the cohort level, enable reminder notifications, and calculate due dates based on cohort, course, period, and timetable context.

workflows.name: Add CorrespondenceCohortSchedule
steps: Add parameters: TimetableID, CorrespondenceID, Days, PeriodCodeID, EmailReminderStaffID

workflows.name: Update CorrespondenceCohortSchedule
steps: Add parameters: ID, CorrespondenceID, Days, PeriodCodeID, EmailReminderStaffID

workflows.name: Get Schedule (by Term, Cohort, Course, Correspondence)
steps: Add parameters: TermID, CohortID, CourseID, CorrespondenceID

business_rules: DueDate calculation depends on PeriodCode and Days value.
PeriodCode can be BEFORESTART, AFTERSTART, BEFOREEND, AFTEREND.
DueDate logic handles fallback for EndDateBlock2 being null (Database.DateIsNull).
Use alternate language fields if session.UseAltLanguageFields.
validations: PeriodCode must be a recognized value.
Dates must be valid (StartDate, EndDate, EndDateBlock2).
IDs must be integers and correspond to valid entities.
calculations: DueDate: Based on PeriodCode - Before/After StartDate/EndDate/EndDateBlock2 and Days offset.
PRDueDate: Based on earliest start/end date of PR.
conditions: If PeriodCode is BEFORESTART, DueDate = StartDate minus Days.
If PeriodCode is AFTERSTART, DueDate = StartDate plus Days.
If PeriodCode is BEFOREEND, DueDate = EndDateBlock2 (if present) minus Days, else EndDate minus Days.
If PeriodCode is AFTEREND, DueDate = EndDateBlock2 (if present) plus Days, else EndDate plus Days.
If session.UseAltLanguageFields true, use TypeDescriptionAlt and PeriodDescriptionAlt.
system_behavior: Retrieves schedules using stored procedures based on context.
Can add, update, delete, and inherit schedules.
Supports multi-language field values based on session.
dependencies: Database layer for date null checks and formatting.
Stored procedures: CorrespondenceCohortSchedulesAdd, Update, Delete, Inherit, SearchID, SearchCorr, QueueSearch, UpdateGenerated.
exceptions: Database.NullDate returned if PeriodCode not recognized.
EndDateBlock2 may be null; fallback to EndDate.
content_gaps: Some business logic (e.g. actual implementation of FillList, DateFormatter, Database.DateIsNull) is not shown.

Details on actor roles and privileges are limited.
